blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Video object removal and injection are reciprocal editing operations between object-present and object-absent video states, yet they differ substantially in training difficulty. Removal can be effectively bootstrapped from video inpainting and further adapted to erase object-related interaction effects. Injection, however, requires large-scale paired supervision to model object appearance, dynamics, and scene-dependent effects, while perfectly aligned real-world pairs are difficult to collect and synthetic data lacks sufficient realism and diversity. To address this challenge, we present UniVOE, a removal-driven framework for training both video object removal and injection models. We first train an effect-aware remover by transferring video inpainting priors and finetuning on object-present/object-absent pairs. The trained remover converts real object-present videos into object-absent counterparts, creating large-scale paired supervision for injection. An injection model is trained on these pairs in the reverse direction to recover objects together with their dynamics and interaction effects. Moreover, since pixel-level reconstruction alone cannot adequately capture perceptual realism, we introduce a reward-based post-training method that aligns injection results with human preferences using a proprietary reward model. Experiments against strong open-source and commercial systems demonstrate that UniVOE achieves state-of-the-art performance on both object removal and injection, particularly in challenging interaction-effect cases.
blocks.zh: 视频对象清除和注入是对象存在和对象存在视频状态之间的对等编辑操作,但在训练难度方面却大相径庭. 清除可以有效地从视频涂装中解脱出来,并进一步调整以抹去与对象相关的交互效应. 然而,注射需要大规模配对监督,以模型化物体外观,动力学,和场景依赖效应,而完全对齐的真世界配对则难以收集,合成数据缺乏足够的现实性和多样性. 为了应对这一挑战,我们提出了UniVOE,这是一个由移除驱动的框架,用于培训视频物体移除和注射模型。 我们首先通过传输视频涂装前科并微调对对象在场/对象的配对,来训练一种能感知效果的清除器. 训练有素的清除器将真实对象存在的视频转换成对象缺失的对等视频,创建了大规模配对的注射监督. 在反方向的这些对子上训练了一种注射模型,以回收物体及其动力学和相互作用效应。 此外,由于光是像素级的重建无法充分捕捉到感知现实主义,我们采用了一种基于奖励的训练后方法,利用专有奖励模式,将注射结果与人类的喜好相配合. 针对强开源系统和商业系统的实验表明,UniVOE在物体清除和注射方面都取得了最先进的性能,特别是在具有挑战性相互作用效应的案例中.

blocks.en: Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video object removal and injection are critical in visual content creation, with broad applications in film post-production, advertising, and virtual production. Unlike image editing, video editing must account for not only the target object itself, but also its dynamic imprint on surrounding scene. A moving object may cast shadows, produce reflections, and contact surfaces. Editing only the object but leaving these interaction effects untreated during removal or synthesizing them incorrectly in injection will produce perceptible artifacts. A practical tool should jointly edit the object and its effects.
blocks.zh: 视频对象的清除和注射对于视觉内容的创作至关重要,在电影后期制作,广告,虚拟制作中都有广泛的应用. 与图像编辑不同,视频编辑不仅必须说明目标对象本身,还必须说明其在周边场景上的动态印记. 移动物体可能投影,产生反射,接触表面. 只编辑对象,但在清除过程中不处理这些相互作用效应,或者在注入时不正确合成这些效应,将产生可感知的文物. 实用工具应联合编辑对象及其效果。

blocks.en: Recent diffusion-based video editing methods made significant progress in fidelity and temporal consistency ( Yang et al. 2026c ; Li et al. 2025a ; Zhou et al. 2023 ; Kushwaha et al. 2026 ; Yang et al. 2026a ) . Some works further recognize the close relationship between object removal and insertion ( Fu et al. 2026 ) : effect-aware removers erase shadows and reflections together with the target object, while reciprocal formulations use insertion as an auxiliary inverse task to improve removal. General video inpainting systems also support adding or removing objects ( Bian et al. 2025 ) . Nevertheless, realistic object injection remains difficult. It must hallucinate absent foreground, infer plausible object motion, and predict interactive effects such as shadows and reflections. The main bottleneck is supervision. Ideally, both directions should be trained with paired videos of the same scene in object present and absent states under identical lighting, and background dynamics. Such pairs are hard to capture in the wild, while synthetic rendering, despite perfect alignment, lacks diversity, photorealism, and dynamics of real footage.
blocks.zh: 最近基于传播的视频编辑方法在忠诚性和时间一致性方面取得了重大进展(杨等人2026c;李等人2025a;周等人. 页:1 2026; Yang et al. 2026a ). 一些作品进一步认识到物体清除和插入之间的密切关系(Fu等人,2026年):效果感知清除器将阴影和反射与目标物体一起抹去,而对等配体则使用插入作为辅助反向任务来改进清除. 一般的影像涂装系统也支持添加或移除对象(Bian等人,2025年) . 尽管如此,现实的物体注射仍然很困难. 它必须产生幻觉,没有前景,推断出似是而非的物体运动,并预测影子和反射等交互效应. 主要瓶颈是监管. 理想的情况是,两个方向应使用同一场景的配对视频,在相同的照明下,在物体存在和缺席状态下进行训练,并采用背景动态。 这种对子在野外很难捕捉,而合成渲染尽管完美对齐,却缺乏多样性,光现实主义,以及真实镜头的动态.

Our key insight is that object removal and injection share the same paired data structure, but are asymmetric in learning difficulty. Let V obj V_{\text{obj}} and V abs V_{\text{abs}} denote the object present and absent states of the same video. The two tasks can be viewed as conditional generation in opposite directions: π rem ​ ( V abs ∣ V obj , c ) ⟺ π inj ​ ( V obj ∣ V abs , c ) \pi_{\text{rem}}(V_{\text{abs}}\mid V_{\text{obj}},\,c)\Longleftrightarrow\pi_{\text{inj}}(V_{\text{obj}}\mid V_{\text{abs}},\,c) ,
where c c denotes the editing condition, such as text prompt in Fig. 1 . The same pair can supervise both directions: removal learns to eliminate the object and its effects, while injection learns to predict them. However, removal can be scaled from video inpainting, which provides abundant supervision for background completion, temporal structure, and scene consistency. With limited paired V obj V_{\text{obj}} - V abs V_{\text{abs}} data, this prior can be adapted to complete object removal and effect erasing. Injection, in contrast, requires cleaner supervision for object appearance, motion, and interaction. This reciprocal-but-asymmetric structure motivates removal-driven strategy: strengthen easier removal direction, and use it to derive supervision for injection.

blocks.en: Figure 2: UniVOE uses removal to scale paired video data up, drives the training of injection.
blocks.zh: 图2:UniVOE使用除去法将配对视频数据向上放大,驱动注射训练.

blocks.en: We propose UniVOE , a removal-driven framework for realistic video object removal and injection. As shown in Fig. 2 , UniVOE first trains an effect-aware remover by transferring scalable inpainting priors to object removal and refines with limited object-present/absent pairs ( Miao et al. 2026 ; Fu et al. 2026 ) . The trained remover is then applied to real object-present videos to derive object-absent counterparts, while the original videos serve as injection targets containing real object motion and interaction effects. These removal-derived pairs, together with limited open-source data, supervise an injection model with flow-matching ( Lipman et al. 2023 ) . However, pixel-wise supervision alone cannot fully close the perceptual gap of injection: for an object-absent video, multiple appearances, trajectories, and contact patterns may be plausible, while failures such as over-saturation, unnatural motion, missing contact shadows, or unrealistic reflections are better captured by perceptual judgment than by reconstruction error. We therefore introduce an online post-training stage tailored to object injection. It employs a proprietary reward model, finetuned from Qwen3-VL ( Bai et al. 2025 ) , to rank the motion quality and naturalness of edited videos, steering optimization toward model’s performance ceiling. More importantly, as an editing task, the complete frame sequence should be fully covered during ranking and training. To make online post-training feasible for large diffusion models at realistic video resolutions and durations, we design a VRAM-efficient Group-Relative Advantage Regression (GRAR). It avoids the memory overhead of maintaining a reference policy while preserving reward-guided training. Experiments demonstrate that UniVOE achieves SOTA empirical results on both video object removal and injection. As shown in Fig. 1 , for removal, it robustly eliminates target objects together with their shadows, reflections, and contact cues. For injection, it synthesizes objects with plausible motion and interaction effects. Compared with strong open-source and commercial systems, UniVOE is competitive and clearly stronger in challenging interaction-effect cases that prior methods often mishandle. Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose an effective training framework to optimize video object removal and injection models with limited real-world paired data, named UniVOE. We exploit their reciprocal-but-asymmetric training structure: removal is first scaled with easier inpainting task and then reused as a supervision engine for the harder injection direction. • To enhance the realism of injection, we develop a novel post-training algorithm, called GRAR, to overcome the limitation of pixel-level reconstruction and align the injected results with human preference. Experiments verify its effectiveness in improving injection quality. • We apply various techniques to removal model for large-scale training data curation. First, object deletion is bootstrapped with video inpainting. Next, we adapt the model with paired data to enable interactive effects removal. Besides, we accelerate inference to facilitate large-scale generation. Finally, we add an effective video filtering mechanism to retain only high-quality data for training. • Extensive comparisons with open-source and commercial systems show that UniVOE achieves SOTA performance on both object removal and injection, especially in challenging interaction-effect erasing and prediction.

blocks.en: Related Work
blocks.zh: 有关工作

blocks.en: Video Object Removal
blocks.zh: 视频对象删除

blocks.en: Video object removal is a special case of video inpainting: the masked region must be filled with plausible and temporally coherent background. Early methods rely on temporal adversarial losses, optical-flow propagation, or spatio-temporal attention to improve completion quality ( Chang et al. 2019 ; Zeng et al. 2020 ; Liu et al. 2021 ; Li et al. 2022 ; Zhou et al. 2023 ; Zhang et al. 2023 ; Gu et al. 2025 ; Gao et al. 2025 ) , recent diffusion-based pipelines extend the generative range to large holes ( Li et al. 2025a ; Bian et al. 2025 ) . These generic inpainters fill the masked region but are not designed to clean up object-induced effects outside the mask. A second line of work, namely effect-aware removal, targets the shadows, reflections, mirror images, and deformations that an object leaves on the surrounding scene ( Miao et al. 2026 ; Kushwaha et al. 2026 ) . EffectErase ( Fu et al. 2026 ) treats object insertion as an auxiliary inverse task to regularize removal. In contrast, we treat removal as a supervision engine for injection: a trained effect-aware remover converts object-present videos into object-absent counterparts for paired supervision of object injection.
blocks.zh: 清除视频物体是视频涂抹的特例:蒙面区域必须充满可信和时间一致的背景. 早期方法依靠时间性对抗性损失、光流传播或时空关注来提高完成质量(Chan等人)。 2019; 曾等编. 2020; 刘等. 2021; 李等编. 2022; 周等编. 2023; 张等. 2023; 顾等. 2025;Gao等人,2025年),最近的基于扩散的管道将基因范围扩大到大孔(Li等人,2025a;Bian等人,2025年). 这些通用的内漆器填充蒙蔽区域,但设计上并不是为了清除蒙蔽外的物体引起的效应. 第二行工作,即效果感知清除,目标是物体在周围现场留下的阴影,反射,镜像,以及变形(Miao等人,2026年;Kushwaha等人,2026年). 效果 Erase(Fu等人,2026年)将对象插入作为辅助反向任务,使清除规范化. 相比之下,我们把清除作为注射的监督引擎:训练有素的效应感知清除器将显示物体的视频转换成显示物体的对应器,用于对物体注射进行配对的监督.

blocks.en: Video Object Injection
blocks.zh: 视频对象注入

blocks.en: Object injection places a target object into a host scene while keeping it visually compatible with background. At image level, prior work has explored exemplar-guided editing, object compositing, and zero-shot object-level customization ( Yang et al. 2023 ; Song et al. 2023 ; Lu et al. 2023 ; Chen et al. 2024 ; Li et al. 2025b ) . Lifting these to video is harder: the inserted object must remain temporally consistent and move coherently. Recent video editing methods add controllability through first-frame editing, reference-object preservation, or compositing ( Ku et al. 2024 ; Mou et al. 2024 ; Wei et al. 2024 ; Tu et al. 2025 ; Yang et al. 2026b ; Ye et al. 2025 ) , but they typically expect the user to specify object identity, motion track, and other injection-related controls up front. Unlike these methods, UniVOE offers lighter interface (text by default, with an optional reference image). This enables flexible use and large-scale paired data curation.
blocks.zh: 对象注入将目标对象放置在主机场景中,同时保持其与背景的视觉兼容性. 在图像层面,先前的工作探索了实例引导编辑,对象堆肥,零镜头对象级定制(杨等人. 2023; 宋等编. 2023; 吕等. 2023; 陈等. 2024; 李等编. 2025b. (中文(简体) ). 将这些内容提升到视频中更难:插入的对象必须保持时间上的一致性,并一致移动. 近期的视频编辑方法通过第一帧编辑,参考对象保存,或堆肥,增加了可控性(Ku等人. 2024; Mou等人著. 2024; 魏等编. 2024; Tu et al. 2025; 杨等. 2026b; Ye et al. 2025),但他们一般期望用户在前面指定对象身份,运动轨迹,以及其他与注射相关的控制. 与这些方法不同,UniVOE提供了较轻的界面(默认文本,带有可选的参考图像). 这样可以灵活使用和大规模配对数据。

blocks.en: Post-training for Preference Alignment
blocks.zh: 优惠调整培训后

blocks.en: Aligning generation results with human perception generally takes one of two routes. Offline preference optimisation ( Rafailov et al. 2023 ; Xu et al. 2023 ; Prabhudesai et al. 2024 ; Wallace et al. 2024 ) fine-tunes the model on a fixed set of pairwise preferences. It is simple and stable, but bound to expensive human annotation, and the model never trains on its own samples. Online post-training instead scores samples drawn from the current policy on the fly, which saves manual annotation and allows the model to explore its higher performance boundaries. Within online for diffusion and flow-matching, recent work explores PPO-style trust regions ( Liu et al. 2026 ) and negative-aware fine-tuning, exemplified by DiffusionNFT ( Zheng and others 2025 ) . Although these are effective on image models, applying them off-the-shelf to large video backbones for editing tasks runs into a memory wall: keeping a frozen reference policy alongside a trainable one, plus storing rollouts of long video latents, needs larger VRAM. Therefore, we propose a VRAM-efficient post-training strategy tailored to video editing. It follows a single-pass reward-weighted regression but discards the reference policy, named GRAR.
blocks.zh: 将生成结果与人类认知相协调一般需要两种途径之一. 离线偏好优化(Rafailov等人. 2023; 许等. 2023; Prabhudesai等人著. 2024; Wallace et al. 2024)在固定的一组对偶偏好上对模型进行了微调. 它简单而稳定,但与昂贵的人类注释有关,模型从未在自己的样本上进行训练. 在线后训练取而代之,对从目前关于苍蝇的政策中抽取的样本进行评分,这可以节省手动注释,使模型能够探索其较高的性能界限. 在网络传播和流量匹配方面,最近的工作探索了PPO式信任区(刘等人,2026年)和负意识微调,以DifmusionNFT(郑等人,2025年)为例。 虽然这些在图像模型上是有效的,但把它们现成的应用到大型视频主干线上,用于编辑任务,却跑进内存墙中:在可训练的外加存储长视频潜伏物,需要更大的VRAM来保存冷冻的参考政策. 因此,我们提出一个针对视频编辑的高效VRAM培训后战略。 它遵循一个单路奖励加权回归,但放弃了名为GRA的参考政策.

blocks.en: Stage 1: Effect-Aware Video Object Removal
blocks.zh: 第一阶段: 效果- 预知视频对象删除

blocks.en: As Fig. 2 shows, video inpainting and object removal share a common goal: recovering background occluded by target region. This similarity allows us to bootstrap object removal from inpainting data. Further, removal requires erasing object-induced interaction effects, e.g. , shadows and reflections that extend beyond object. We train remover in two steps: inpainting pretraining and effect-aware fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,视频插图和对象清除有一个共同的目标:恢复目标区域占据的背景。 这种相似性使我们可以从涂抹数据中去除诱饵对象。 此外,清除需要消除物体引起的相互作用效应,例如,超越物体的阴影和反射。 我们分两步训练清除器:涂抹预训和效果感知微调.

blocks.en: We employ SAM2 ( Ravi et al. 2025 ) to segment foreground objects in real-world videos, obtain their masks M M . We collect over 63K high-quality videos containing salient objects and apply Gaussian dilation to M M to ensure sufficient coverage of object boundaries. In training, we randomly sample two videos, V ​ i ​ d A Vid_{A} and V ​ i ​ d B Vid_{B} , and use M M from V ​ i ​ d B Vid_{B} to mask corresponding regions in V ​ i ​ d A Vid_{A} , producing realistic object-shaped missing regions with temporal variations. The masked V ​ i ​ d A Vid_{A} is used as input, while the original V ​ i ​ d A Vid_{A} serves as the ground truth. The removal model is optimized with the reconstruction loss in Eq. ( 2 ), enabling it to learn a strong scene completion prior for plausibly recovering background content occluded by objects.

During training, we use inflated object mask M M that fully covers the target object but leaves interaction effects outside. This encourages the model to recover the complete object-absent scene rather than merely inpainting the object region, while improving robustness to inaccurate masks at inference time. blocks.en: When applying remover to large-scale data curation, its inference cost directly limits the scale of paired data we can generate. To accelerate it, we distill remover from the default 50 50 -steps sampling into 12 12 -steps. Concretely, we shorten the flow-matching sampler to 12 12 -steps with a fixed sigma shift of 5.0 5.0 , and finetune with Eq. ( 2 ). To synchronize timesteps of the backbone and branch, we add a LoRA ( Hu et al. 2022 ) of rank 32 32 to attention and feed-forward layers of backbone, jointly update the full branch together with LoRA. In inference, we directly remove objects in 12 12 -steps, making large-scale object-absent video generation practical. Note that our removal results in this paper are all generated from distilled 12 12 -steps model, which yields a substantial speed-up with imperceptible quality degradation.

blocks.en: Post-training methods mainly require double models, a reference policy, a trainable policy, with multiple forward passes. This is because, limited by reward hacking, updates driven solely by rewards cause the model to overfit or collapse into a spurious optimum, far removed from the high-quality distribution learned in pre-training. Hence, reference policy is necessary to constrain post-training scope, but inevitably increases VRAM overhead, limiting its potential for use in larger-scale models. Existing methods are mainly applied to image models or small video backbones such as 1.3B ( Pan et al. 2025 ) . But as to stronger video model such as our injector with 23B parameters, using off-the-shelf solutions is infeasible. One workaround is to reduce VRAM usage by sampling partial frames for training. However, for video editing tasks, abnormal editing effects in any frame are intolerable, i.e. , training with full frame sequence is essential for editing. In our case, using 97 frames of 480p leads to unacceptably VRAM load.
blocks.zh: 培训后的方法主要需要双模式,参考政策,可训练政策,并有多个前行通行证. 这是因为,受奖励黑客的限制,完全受奖励驱动的更新导致模型过度适应或崩溃,成为虚假的最佳,远离在预训中学会的高质量分布. 因此,有必要制定参考政策,以限制培训后的范围,但不可避免地增加VRAM的间接费用,限制其在更大规模模式中使用的潜力。 现有方法主要应用于图像模型或小视频骨干,如1.3B(Pan等人,2025年). 但是,对于更强大的视频模型,比如我们的注射器有23B参数,使用现成的解决方案是不可行的. 一个变通办法是通过对培训部分框架进行取样,减少VRAM的使用。 然而,对于视频编辑任务,任何帧中的异常编辑效果都是不可容忍的,也就是说,带有全帧序列的培训对于编辑至关重要. 就我们来说,使用97帧的480p会导致令人无法接受的VRAM负载.

blocks.en: To this end, we propose Group-Relative Advantage Regression (GRAR), a single-policy surrogate that preserves preference-aligned optimization without a separate reference model. We rethink the role of reference policy from the nature of video editing. Reference policy constrains the magnitude of post-training for generation. However, for editing, input video itself constrains the output content, i.e. , the model does not generate a new video from scratch but merely modifies parts, with the core content directly dictated by input video. Therefore, GRAR only regress single trainable policy with reward values without redundant reference policy.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们提出集团优势退让(GRAR),这是一个单一政策代位,在没有单独参考模式的情况下保持优惠相适应优化. 我们重新思考参考政策的作用, 参考政策限制了一代人接受后培训的规模。 然而,对于编辑,输入视频本身会约束输出内容,即该模式并不从零开始生成新视频,而只是修改部分,核心内容直接由输入视频来决定. 因此,全球资源评估只退却单一的可训练政策,其奖励价值没有多余的参考政策。

During inference, both remover and injector support 2 conditioning paradigms: text-only or text-and-reference image. As some compared methods require reference image to inject objects. blocks.en: We realize SOTA removal ability by bootstrapping with inpainting. We compare two ablation settings to support this claim: (1) “UniVOE-”, a degraded model trained on 68K hybrid data, including 34K inpainting pairs and 34K removal pairs. (2) “w/o inpainting” that is totally trained on 68K removal pairs. Note that UniVOE- only uses part of inpainting and removal pairs to train, which aims to maintain the same data scale as “w/o inpainting” for fair comparison. This is because the paired object-present/absent pairs capture in the wild cannot ensure pixel-level background consistency, using such noisy data to train misleads the model to over-edit, changing overall pixels even they are actually not related to the removed object. While inpainting data guaranties strict pixel-level correspondence, improving background preservation ability.

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: We presented UniVOE, a removal-driven framework for realistic video object removal and injection. Our key observation is that the two tasks share the same object-present/object-absent training structure, but differ in learning difficulty: removal can be easily bootstrapped from scalable video inpainting, whereas injection requires strict data pairs for object motion, contact, and interaction effects. UniVOE turns this reciprocal-but-asymmetric structure into a new training strategy. It first learns a strong effect-aware remover, then uses the remover to derive object-absent counterparts from real object-present videos, making the original videos serve as supervision for injection. To further address the perceptual ambiguity left by reconstruction loss, UniVOE introduces an online reward-based post-training stage and Group-Relative Advantage-Regression (GRAR), enabling VRAM-efficient preference-aligned optimization for large video diffusion backbones. Extensive experiments show that UniVOE achieves SOTA performance on object editing, with clear advantages on challenging interaction-effect cases such as shadows, reflections, and motion-dependent visual changes.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了UniVOE,这是一个现实的视频物体清除和注射的移除驱动框架。 我们的关键观察是,这两个任务都具有相同的对象存在/对象缺失训练结构,但在学习难度上却有所不同:清除可以很容易地从可伸缩的视频涂装中脱落,而注射则需要严格的数据对对象运动,接触,和相互作用效果. UnivoE将这种对等但不对称的结构转变为新的培训战略。 它首先学习强效知觉除尘器,然后使用除尘器从真实的物体呈现的视频中得出对象缺失的对应物,使原视频成为注射的监管. 为了进一步解决重建损失留下的观念模糊问题,UniVOE引入了基于在线奖励的后培训阶段和Group-Relative Advantage-Reression(GRAR),使得VRAM高效的偏好组合优化大型视频传播主干线. 广泛的实验显示,UniVOE在对象编辑上实现了SOTA性能,在挑战交互效应案例,如阴影,反射,和运动依赖的视觉变化上有着明显的优势.

blocks.en: Appendix A Video Filtering Gate for Removal Counterparts
blocks.zh: 用于移除的视频过滤门

blocks.en: As described in the main paper, our injector is pre-trained on removal-derived pairs: we run the effect-aware remover π rem \pi_{\rm rem} on real object-present videos V obj V_{\rm obj} to obtain object-absent counterparts V abs V_{\rm abs} , and reverse the direction so that V obj V_{\rm obj} becomes a photorealistic injection target. This bootstrap is only as clean as the remover output. A pair in which the remover left a residual object, a hole, or a ghosting artifact, or in which it corrupted the background outside the object region, is worse than useless as injection supervision: reversing such a pair teaches the injector to hallucinate incomplete objects or to repaint background that should stay fixed. We therefore pass every removal-derived pair through an automatic filtering gate before it enters the injection training set 𝒟 inj \mathcal{D}_{\rm inj} , and apply the same gate to open-source object-present/absent pairs ( Fu et al. 2026 ) . This section details that gate.
blocks.zh: 如主要论文所述, 我们的注射器在去除衍生的对子上接受了预先训练: 在真实对象的视频 V obj V_{\rm obj} 上运行效果感知器 π rem\pi_{\rm  re obj} 以获取对等对象 V abs V_{\rm abs} 并反转方向, V obj V_{\rm obj} 成为光现实的注射目标 。 这个靴子只有清除器输出的一样干净. 清除者留下残余物体,洞,或鬼物,或使物体区域外的背景腐烂的一对,比注射监督无用的还要糟糕: 倒置这样的一对,教注射者幻灭不完整物体,或重新油漆应当固定的背景. 因此,我们在进入D inj\mathcal{D}_{\rm inj}的注射训练装置之前,通过自动过滤门,将每个取出物的对子通过,并将同一门用于开源对象现/出物对子(Fu等人,2026年). 本节详述该门.

blocks.en: The gate is region-aware: it distinguishes the object region (where the object must disappear) from the background (which must be preserved). For each clip we localize the target with GroundingDINO on the first frame, propagate the box through SAM2 to obtain a per-frame instance mask, and take the union over all target objects into a single binary mask. The mask is softly dilated (Gaussian blur followed by a low threshold) so that the “inside” region covers the object together with a margin for its immediate interaction effects, and the complement defines the background region used for the fidelity check below.
blocks.zh: 门是区域认识的:它区分物体区域(物体必须消失的地方)与背景(必须保存). 对于每个片段,我们在第一帧上用GroundingDINO定位目标,通过SAM2传播盒子以获得每帧实例遮罩,并将所有目标对象的结合带入一个单一的二进制遮罩. 口罩被软地膨胀(格乌西亞模糊,后加低阈值),这样"内"区域会覆盖物体,并有其即时相互作用效应的幅度,补充物定义了用于下面的忠诚度检查的背景区域.

blocks.en: A pair is accepted only if it passes both of the following, mirroring the two failure modes of removal: • Background fidelity (outside the dilated mask). The remover must not over-edit the scene. We measure the residual change between V abs V_{\rm abs} and V obj V_{\rm obj} restricted to the background region; a pair is rejected when this residual is large, indicating that the remover altered content unrelated to the target (e.g., a global color shift or repainted structure). • Removal completeness (inside the mask). The target must be genuinely gone, not merely faded, partially erased, displaced, or replaced by a look-alike. We assess the object region by visual-semantic comparison between V abs V_{\rm abs} and V obj V_{\rm obj} ; any surviving trace of the target causes rejection.
blocks.zh: 一对只有在经过以下两种情况下才被接受,这反映了两个失败的去除方式: ^ 背景忠心(在膨胀的面具外). 清除器不得过度编辑现场. 我们测量V abs V_{\rm abs} 和 V obj V_{\rm obj} 之间的剩余变化, 仅限于背景区域; 当这个剩余值很大时, 一对被拒绝, 表示清除器更改了与目标无关的内容(例如全球色移或再油漆结构). • 清除完整性(面具内)。 目标必须真正消失,而不只是淡出、被部分抹去、流离失所,或者被外观相似者所取代。 我们通过V abs V_{\rm abs}和V obj V_{\rm obj}之间的视觉语义比较来评估对象区域;目标的任何存活痕迹都会引起拒绝.

blocks.en: Because “a surviving trace” and “an unnatural background” are perceptual rather than pixel-exact, both criteria are adjudicated by a vision-language judge (Qwen3-VL) run at temperature 0 0 for determinism. The judge is prompted to (i) re-caption both videos and enumerate every object present in V obj V_{\rm obj} but absent in V abs V_{\rm abs} , not only the one named in the removal instruction, since the remover sometimes cleanly deletes co-occurring objects, (ii) list the actual changes, (iii) run an explicit residual check for any leftover trace of the target, and (iv) emit a binary decision with a short reason. The instruction that produced the clip is provided only as the intended edit; the judge is told to compare the two videos independently rather than trust the instruction, so that imperfect removals are not waved through. The decision rule is strict-by-default: when the judge is uncertain whether the object is fully gone, it rejects.
blocks.zh: 由于“幸存的痕迹”和“非自然背景”是可感知的,而不是像素精确的,因此这两种标准都由视力语言法官(Qune3-VL)在0度温度下进行判定。 法官被要求 (一) 重新抓取视频,并列出Vobj V_{\rm obj}中存在但Vabs V_{\rm abs}中缺失的每个对象,不仅指去除指令中点名的物体,因为去除者有时会干净地删除共同发生的物体, (二) 列出实际变化, (三) 对目标的任何遗留痕迹进行明确的剩余检查, (四) 发出一个二进制决定,理由短. 制作剪辑的指令仅作为预定编辑提供;法官被告知要独立比较这两段视频,而不是信任指令,这样不完美的删除不会被挥过. 裁判规则严格按违约处理:当法官不确定对象是否完全消失时,会拒绝.

blocks.en: Full-frame video judgment tends to overlook small residuals that appear only in the middle or late frames. To harden the completeness check, we add a second, focused pass that operates only on the object region: we crop the dilated mask bounding box from V obj V_{\rm obj} and V abs V_{\rm abs} , tile eight uniformly sampled frames of each into a static grid, and ask the judge to inspect the result grid cell by cell. If any cell still shows the target — complete, partial, a faded outline, or a similar substitute — the pair is rejected. Static grids expose per-frame detail that a played-back video dilutes, making this pass stricter than the video-level judgment; a pair must clear both to be retained.
blocks.zh: 全帧视频判断往往忽略只出现在中框或后框的小残片. 为了更严格地检查完整性,我们增加了一个只运行在对象区域的第二张有重点的通行证:我们从V obj V_{\rm obj}和 V abs V_{\rm abs} 将每个的8个统一取样的帧划入一个静电格,并要求法官通过单元格检查结果电格。 如果有任何单元格仍然显示目标——完整,部分,淡出的轮廓,或类似的替代品——则该对被拒绝. 静态网格暴露出每个帧的细节,即播放回放的视频会稀释,使得这个传球比视频级别的判断更严格;一对必须清空两对必须保留.

blocks.en: The gate is embedded in the multi-node removal pipeline: each node runs the remover and the judge over a shard of clips, with many judge queries issued concurrently, so filtering keeps pace with generation across the cluster. After applying the gate, we retain 69K high-quality removal-derived pairs, which are combined with 68K gate-filtered open-source pairs to form the injection pre-training set 𝒟 inj \mathcal{D}_{\rm inj} .
blocks.zh: 闸门嵌入了多节点移除管道:每个节点将移除器和法官运行在一块硬片片上,同时发布许多法官查询,因此过滤与整个集群的生成保持同步. 在应用门后,我们保留了69K高品质的去除衍生的对,它们与68K门滤开源对结合,形成注射前训练集D inj\mathcal{D}_{\rm inj}.

Each iteration first rolls out K K candidates per context from the frozen rollout policy π θ old inj \pi_{\theta_{\rm old}}^{\rm inj} and scores them with the human-aligned reward model Q θ Q_{\theta} . A { + 1 , − 1 } \{+1,-1\} signed advantage is then assigned by comparing each score against the group median r ~ c \tilde{r}_{c} , which keeps the update bounded and insensitive to the absolute reward scale. Finally, each rollout is re-used as an online flow-matching sample and the single trainable policy π θ inj \pi_{\theta}^{\rm inj} is regressed toward ( A = + 1 A{=}{+}1 ) or away from ( A = − 1 A{=}{-}1 ) its own velocity target. No reference policy is stored or forwarded, so the only network instantiated during optimization is π θ inj \pi_{\theta}^{\rm inj} itself, making full-sequence (97-frame, 480p) post-training of the 23B injector feasible within an 80 GB VRAM budget.

blocks.en: GRAR shares the negative-aware spirit of DiffusionNFT ( Zheng and others 2025 ) , an online post-training method for flow-matching models, but removes its frozen reference policy. In this section we make the relation precise. We first restate the GRAR objective in a self-contained form, then show that (i) the GRAR gradient is first-order consistent with the reward policy gradient (Proposition 2), and (ii) the GRAR update coincides with the negative-anchored DiffusionNFT update up to a first-order residual in the step size (Lemma 1), while instantiating only a single trainable network. We close with the memory argument and the 1.3 1.3 B empirical comparison.

blocks.en: The injector inherits whatever biases survive the filtering gate. The gate is strict-by-default and removes pairs with residual objects or corrupted background, but it cannot manufacture supervision that the remover never produces. Consequently, injection quality is upper-bounded by the coverage of the remover and the retained pairs. Designing more efficient post-training algorithms for injectors is an effective way to break through the performance ceiling imposed by the training set. This has been proven in our paper. In addition, jointly improving the remover and injector, or recycling high-reward injection rollouts back into the training pool, is also a natural way to break this dependence. We leave this cycle-like coordinated training strategy as a future work.

However, developing more diverse and preference-aligned reward model will further improve the quality of reward-guided post-training. Our team will continue to develop reward models for videos and apply and open-source them in future work.

blocks.en: One might argue that, as video foundation models keep scaling, future backbones will natively support universal human and object removal and injection, which would seem to diminish the value of dedicated specialist models such as ours. We take the opposite view, for two reasons that our results directly support. First, scale alone does not close the gap on vertical editing tasks: despite orders-of-magnitude fewer parameters, our 23 23 B specialist outperforms much larger general-purpose systems in our comparisons (e.g., the 200 200 B-parameter Seedance 2.0), indicating that task-specific data curation and post-training remain decisive for editing quality that generic base models do not yet deliver. Second, and more fundamentally, training a foundation model to edit natively requires millions of paired before/after editing supervision clips, which is infeasible to obtain by manual annotation alone. Industrial pipelines therefore rely on dedicated data operators that synthesize such pairs automatically. UniVOE is precisely such an operator: coupled with the strict quality gate, it can emit large volumes of high-quality object-present/object-absent and injection pairs, which are exactly the supervision a foundation model needs during its SFT stage. In this sense, specialist editing models are not superseded by stronger foundation models; they become the engines that supply the paired data on which those foundation models are trained. This reframes the contribution of UniVOE from a standalone editor to a reusable component of the broader video-model data ecosystem.
blocks.zh: 人们可能会认为,随着视频基础模型的不断扩大,未来的骨干将在当地支持普遍的人类和物体的清除和注射,这似乎会降低像我们这样的专门专家模型的价值。 我们持相反的观点,原因有两个,我们的结果直接支持。 首先,单是规模并不能弥补纵向编辑任务的缺口:尽管宽度命令减少了参数,但我们的23个B专家在比较中比较大的通用系统(例如200个B参数的种子2.0)要好得多,这表明特定任务的数据整理和培训后对于通用基础模型尚未提供的编辑质量仍然具有决定性作用。 第二,更根本的是,培训一种本土编辑的基础模式需要编辑监督片段之前/之后的数百万对,而仅靠人工注释是行不通的。 因此,工业管道依赖自动合成这种配对的专用数据运营商。 UnivoE正是这样一个操作者:加上严格的质量门,它可以放出大量高质量的物体存在/物体缺失和注入对,这些正是SFT阶段的基础模型需要的监督. 从这个意义上讲,专业编辑模型并没有被更强大的基础模型所取代;它们成为提供配对数据的引擎,这些基础模型就是用来培训这些基础模型的. 这重新界定了UniVOE从独立的编辑器到更广泛的视频模型数据生态系统的可重复使用组件的贡献.
